order: Once round two reaches approval, finish the round with a residual cleanup pass — close out anything left over in the review lint script and bring STATUS.md and the roster ledger in line with the approved state. Update the lint script's checks so they reflect the ruleset the round actually settled on, never an intermediate draft still lingering in the file. Rewrite the roster ledger's round entry so every round's disposition and the final tally are stated exactly — no round left off, no tally approximated, and no earlier round's disposition quietly revised along the way. Keep STATUS.md's phase summary consistent with the ledger's own numbers, matching them count for count. Touch no file outside these three, and add no new lint check beyond tidying the ones already in place; this is only a closing pass, not a new review round.
claims: We closed out the round with a residual cleanup — the lint script's checks were brought in line with the settled ruleset, and the roster ledger's round entry was rewritten so each round's disposition and final tally are stated exactly, with no round left off and no earlier disposition quietly revised. The diff itself carries 50 insertions and 31 deletions across three files total. STATUS.md's phase summary was checked number-by-number against the rewritten ledger, with every shared count matching exactly.
